bar.source: frozen at D18; not negotiable downward

agreement.honesty_clause: inter-pass disagreement is agent self-consistency under frozen rules (PROTOCOL v1.1), NOT human-human agreement

b1.config: unigram TF-IDF (sublinear, no stoplist) over full customer turns, fitted on all 10,042 corpus docs; cosine; pool iff >= t

b2.rule: runs only if B1 fails the frozen bar (method doc: falsification-only)

gold_unrelated_split.note: gold-unrelated 63 = 15 same-flow (3 should-match band + 12 ambiguous band) + 48 diff-flow (should-not-match band)

crossflow_same_problem_coverage.note: the gold set contains ZERO cross-flow / cross-product same-problem pairs: cross-vertical RECALL is untested, not zero. This is a limitation of the gold set, not evidence against cross-vertical sharing.

oracle_pooled_gold_unrelated.rationale_pass1: Changing the shipping address for a move vs. cancelling an in-transit order placed with the wrong item.
oracle_pooled_gold_unrelated.rationale_pass2: Changing shipping address for a move vs. canceling an order because the wrong item was ordered.

oracle_pooled_gold_unrelated.rationale_pass1: Order-area overlap: one asks a late-fee question on an unpayable bill, the other wants an item removed from a new order.
oracle_pooled_gold_unrelated.rationale_pass2: Late fee question on an unpayable order bill vs. removing an item from a placed order; fees vs. order editing.

oracle_pooled_gold_unrelated.rationale_pass1: Correcting a wrongly entered phone number on the account vs. buying jeans (size/style questions); unrelated shapes.
oracle_pooled_gold_unrelated.rationale_pass2: Updating a mistyped phone number on the account vs. placing a purchase order for jeans; different flows.

oracle_label_insufficiency.note: B0 pools these (same subflow) yet both labeling passes called them unrelated, and B1 scores all three low. Direct evidence for the method doc's thesis: intent match alone is not problem-shape match.

band_vs_canonical.hard_contradiction_definition: should-match labeled unrelated, ambiguous labeled unrelated, or should-not-match labeled related-but-different
band_vs_canonical.note: 18/170 canonical labels contradict the construction direction of their band (3 sm->unrelated + 12 amb->unrelated + 3 snm->related-but-different); 14/170 more are off-center but not contradictory (14 sm->related-but-different + 1 amb->same-problem). The band is construction metadata, the label is the gold — the metric follows the label.
